title: log/follower_tracking.csv is a dead artifact every monitor re-notices because nothing owns it
evidence: log/follower_tracking.csv: 29 bytes, one row (2026-05-22T17:04:27Z,144,125), mtime May 22, NOT tracked by git (git ls-files --error-unmatch: pathspec did not match). No writer and no reader anywhere in the repo or the profile: grep for follower_tracking across the repo (excluding node_modules/.git) and ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival returns only MONITOR REPORTS that cite it as misleading -- the overnight watchdog has flagged it as a 'legacy dead artifact ... misleading surface' in at least three separate passes (log/overnight_watchdog.log lines 30/39/1052) and the 2026-09-21 08:56 watchdog entry re-derived it again. The live surface is the growth_snapshots table (30 snapshots/24h, id 968 latest). Nothing re-breaks, nothing is broken -- but the file is re-diagnosed from scratch every pass, which is exactly what the board exists to stop.

notes.note: Known-accepted condition, recorded so no pass re-derives it. Verified 2026-09-21 14:0xZ: the file has no producer and no consumer (grep across the repo + the whole profile returns only monitor reports), it is untracked, and growth_snapshots is the real series. The only fix that removes the misleading surface is deleting a 29-byte untracked file, which is Tim's call (destructive actions need explicit confirmation) -- so this is closed as accepted, not fixed. Reports should stop citing it: the growth line already reads growth_snapshots.
